package.name: trainit_data
package.description: TrainIt Data Foundation, the canonical core (ADR-0029). TrainIt's persisted data contracts -- observations, captures, sessions, calibration records, dataset versions, labels, splits, exports -- in pure Python, with no ROS, simulator or training-framework dependency, so a training or provider environment and Isaac's own Python can use it without the ROS tree. External formats (YOLO, COCO, LeRobotDataset, MCAP) are exporters, never the canonical model. Live ROS acquisition is the sibling package trainit_data_ros. Slice D0.1: the records, the vocabulary, the store, the crash-safe session writer, verify / recover and the trainit-data CLI (inspect, verify, recover). Slice D0.6: datasets, immutable content-hashed versions, label sets, group-aware splits, the YOLO detection exporter and label importer. M4.5: the YOLO segmentation export of INSTANCE_MASK label sets (pure-numpy contour extraction).
